'''Braem''' was a city of [[Coremanda]], one of the [[Ten Nations]]. It was built by [[Ogier]], but was not the capital. It was destroyed by [[Shadowspawn]] during the [[Trolloc Wars]]. The modern town of [[New Braem]] in [[Andor]] is located near its ruins. Braem gave its name to the surrounding extensive forests, which are now known collectively as [[Braem Wood]].
